programs.source: Entries count_candidates(const Candidates *c,const BasketList *baskets,int64_t minimum,bool extended){Entries result={0};for(int j=0;j<c->count;j++){int64_t count=support_count(baskets,c->values[j],extended);if(count>=minimum)append_entry(&result,(Entry){c->values[j],count});}return result;}
